offers_products.reason: Manufactures mineral fiber, metal and wood ceiling panels, suspension grid systems and wall solutions.

offers_services.reason: Sells manufactured ceiling and wall products; ordering, delivery and design help only support product sales.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Mainly commercial ceilings sold via distributors and contractors; the small residential line is a side business.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Ceilings for offices, schools, healthcare and retail are bought by distributors, contractors and building owners.

recurring_revenue.reason: Sales are tied to renovation and construction projects rather than subscriptions or consumable reorders.

cyclical_demand.reason: Commercial renovation and new construction ceiling projects can be postponed in a downturn.

big_ticket.reason: Ceiling panels and grid are building components bought in routine lots, not large one-off purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from manufactured ceiling and wall products, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Buyers are mainly distributors and installing contractors, plus building owners across many project types.

asset_heavy.reason: Runs manufacturing plants for mineral fiber ceilings, grid and metal products, which need ongoing capital investment.

notes: Customer mix is inferred from general knowledge; the website text doesn't say who the buyers are.
